title: Block-Isospectral Invariance Obstructions, Multi-Subspace Dissipation, Product-Formula Stability Bifurcations, and Subset-Optimal Weight Duality for Excited-State Double-Bracket Flows
abstract: Aghaei Saem, Sahebi, Holmes, and Suzuki (2026, arXiv:2611.34871v1) established a double-bracket flow (DBF) framework for simultaneously preparing the r lowest eigenstates of a d-dimensional Hamiltonian H via continuous-time, discretized, and product-formula evolutions on rank-r mixtures, proving the overlap necessary condition A_i = <lambda_i|P_r|lambda_i> > 0, the dissipation lower bound ||[rho, H]||_HS^2 >= 2 DeltaE (gamma_min - DeltaE), step-size bounds s_bar = 2/gamma_max and 12/(7 gamma_max), Chebyshev scheduling, and degenerate-weight single-excited-state preparation (Theorem EM1). We resolve four foundational structural, dynamical, stability, and optimization questions left open by their theory via four exact theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero external imports, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float exact-rational SHA-256 certificates (MANIFEST SHA-256: 94fb63331545e03fce19c45b2838227491d7f329ba304ab199d5fcf46b048010), and 60 adversarial tests: (1) Exact Block-Isospectral Invariance, Strict Separation from Eq. (6), and Complete Hyperbolic Morse-Index Classification: any spectral projector Pi_S commuting with rho_ref commutes identically with rho under all three DBFs and all step sizes s_k > 0, conserving all power traces Tr((Pi_S rho Pi_S)^m) and requiring multiset block-spectral compatibility spec(Pi_{S_m} rho_ref Pi_{S_m}) = {p_a : a in S_m} on connected components of G(rho_ref); an explicit d=3, r=2 rational witness satisfies A_1 = 1/2 > 0, A_2 = 1 > 0, and rank(Pi_2 P_2 Pi_2) = 2 yet stays permanently trapped at DeltaE(rho) >= gamma_{1,2} = 1/3 > 0, while all d!/(d-r)! fixed points rho_sigma are classified as hyperbolic critical points with exact Jacobian eigenvalues mu_{ab}(sigma) = -(q_a - q_b)(lambda_b - lambda_a), unstable real dimension 2 inv(q) in [0, r(2d-r-1)], unique sink, exact r index-1 saddles, unique source, and multi-level excess bound DeltaE(rho_sigma) >= sum_{j=1}^r gamma_{j,j+1} k_j(sigma); (2) Exact Cross-Subspace Dissipation Identity, Concentration-Ratio Sharpening Above gamma_min, Global Tightness, and Strictly Tighter Discrete Contraction: ||[rho, H]||_HS^2 = 2 sum (delta p_j)^2 l_j + 4 sum_{j<m} delta p_j delta p_m l_{j,m} sharpens Lemma 1 via the concentration ratio C(rho) = sum x_j^2 / (DeltaE)^2 in [1/r, 1] to ||[rho, H]||_HS^2 >= 2 DeltaE (gamma_bar(rho) - C(rho) DeltaE) with exact nonnegative surplus 2 sum (gamma_{j,j+1} - gamma_min) x_j + 4 sum_{j<m} x_j x_m certifying strictly positive dissipation up to r gamma_min, while the 2-level geodesic |lambda_{j*}> <-> |lambda_{j*+1}> attains exact global equality in Lemma 1, Lemma G.2, and Theorem G.1(1), and discrete logistic contraction tightens to y_{k+1} <= y_k (1 - 2 b_k gamma_min / (1 + 2 b_k x_0)) < y_k / (1 + 2 b_k gamma_min), reducing step counts to (kappa + x_0/gamma_min) ln(c_0/eps) and (7 kappa/6 + x_0/gamma_min) ln(c_0/eps); (3) Discretized Period-Doubling Stall Bifurcation, Exact Product-Formula Complex Spectrum, and Unbalanced-Mode Chebyshev Instability: exact 2-level reduction theta_{k+1} = theta_k - s_k gamma sin(theta_k) proves algebraic breakdown DeltaE(rho_k) ~ 3 gamma / (8k) at u = 2 and a unique locally asymptotically stable symmetric period-2 stall orbit sin(theta*)/theta* = 2/u for all u in (2, pi) (explaining Fig. 6(a)), while the exact product-formula linearized multiplier |mu_{ab}^PF|^2 = 1 - 8 sin(u_H/2) sin(u_rho/2) cos((u_H+u_rho)/2) and 2-level nonlinear energy step reproduce all three fourth-order constants (1/6, 1/6, 1/4) of Theorem C.3, prove AM-GM optimality of theta/tau = Omega/p_1 with sharp threshold s_crit^PF = pi^2/(4 gamma_max) > 2/gamma_max > 12/(7 gamma_max), and establish the unbalanced-mode Chebyshev dichotomy (m = 2 stable for all kappa >= 1 vs. m = 4 unstable at kappa = 100 with sum u_k sin(u_k) < -1/2, explaining Fig. 15(b)); and (4) Subset-Optimal Degenerate Weight Duality and Exact Adaptive Untracked-Gap Asymmetry: for any target subset T with boundary set J(T) (permitting exact degeneracies delta lambda_{j+1} = 0 outside J(T)), gamma_min(p) <= (sum_{j in J(T)} j/delta lambda_{j+1})^{-1} and kappa(p) >= Omega sum_{j in J(T)} 1/delta lambda_{j+1}, strictly beating Theorem EM1 for T = {r} whenever delta lambda_r != delta lambda_{r+1} by up to 2x in kappa and (2r-1)/(r-1) in (2, 3]x in gamma_min, while perturbed inverse-gap weights obey kappa(p_hat) = Omega (sum 1/g_hat_j)(max g_hat_j/delta lambda_{j+1}) <= (c_+/c_-) kappa*(T) with an exact (r-1)-to-1 untracked-gap asymmetry explaining Fig. 13's min-rule advantage.
